notes:
I found one pick I can support from an operator's own page. The other two obvious Ottawa venues didn't get one.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Canadian Children’s Museum, Canadian Museum of History",
      "source_name": "Canadian Museum of History",
      "source_url": "https://www.historymuseum.ca/childrens-museum",
      "name_evidence": "Welcome to the Canadian Children’s Museum!",
      "when": "Published hours for Sept. 8 to Dec. 9, 2026: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday 9 am to 5 pm; Thursday 9 am to 7 pm. Hours for September 4 to 6, 2027 are not posted yet.",
      "schedule_kind": "term",
      "when_evidence": "Sept. 8 to Dec. 9, 2026"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **Location:** The page says the museum is 
nestled within the Canadian Museum of History in Gatineau, just minutes from downtown Ottawa
. It is across the river in Quebec, not in Ottawa itself.
- **Window not confirmed:** The hours above are for fall 2026, so I couldn't confirm the museum is open on September 4 to 6, 2027. September 6, 2027 is Labour Day, so check the hours for that day before you go.
- **Age and price:** The page gives no age range and no ticket price for the Children's Museum, so I've left both out. It does say 
general admission tickets include access to the Museum of History and the Canadian Children’s Museum
.

**Canada Science and Technology Museum and Canadian Museum of Nature:** My searches returned only third-party pages for the Science and Technology Museum, such as maps and review sites. For the Museum of Nature, the only page from its own site was a groups page with no regular hours. I couldn't tie any hours or ages to either operator's own page, so I left both out. They are real venues, but I haven't confirmed anything about them for those dates.

**Zoos, aquariums and playgrounds:** I didn't search for these, so this list says nothing about them.
